def VTask.piEquivPiSubtypeProd : {α : Type u_9} → (p : α → Prop) → (β : α → Type u_10) → [DecidablePred p] → ((i : α) → β i) ≃ ((i : { x // p x }) → β ↑i) × ((i : { x // ¬p x }) → β ↑i)
  := fun {α} p β => fun _ =>
    {
      toFun := fun f =>
        {
          -- Define the forward map: split the function into positive and negative parts
          first := fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => f x,
          second := fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => f x
        },
      invFun := fun ⟨f₁, f₂⟩ =>
        -- Define the inverse map: combine the two functions back into one
        fun x => if hx : p x then f₁ ⟨x, hx⟩ else f₂ ⟨x, hx⟩,
      left_inv := fun f => funext fun x => by
        -- Prove that the inverse of the forward map is the identity
        by_cases hx : p x
        · -- Case: p x is true
          simp [hx]
          <;> congr 1 <;> ext <;> simp [hx]
          <;> aesop
        · -- Case: p x is false
          simp [hx]
          <;> congr 1 <;> ext <;> simp [hx]
          <;> aesop
      right_inv := fun ⟨f₁, f₂⟩ => by
        -- Prove that the forward map of the inverse is the identity
        ext <;>
        (try cases') <;>
        (try simp_all [Subtype.ext_iff]) <;>
        (try aesop) <;>
        (try {
          ext x
          by_cases hx : p x <;> simp_all [hx]
          <;> aesop
        }) <;>
        (try {
          ext ⟨x, hx⟩
          simp_all [hx]
          <;> aesop
        })
    }
